better-sg-reports.js.description: This script creates a comprehensive, branded dashboard for analyzing SiteGround server and site performance metrics, focusing on CPU, memory, and request data. It helps users visualize trends, detect issues, and evaluate the impact of fixes through various charts, reports, and statistical tests.
usage: Inject the bookmarklet or userscript while logged into SiteGround's Admin Panel on the relevant pages.
Ensure all API reports are loaded by navigating through the Statistics panels, as the script intercepts fetch calls to gather data.
Open the dashboard via the provided interface buttons, which wait until enough data has been captured or allow you to override this.
Use the report and export options to generate printable PDFs or CSV summaries for sharing or further analysis.

ie-extractor.js.description: This script creates a floating image extractor panel on any page, which collects all images, detects if they are from iStock, and displays them in a sortable table. You can filter images by filename, alt text, or iStock ID, select images, and download their files directly. It enhances image management without altering page content permanently.
usage: Run the bookmarklet while on a page with images to activate the extractor panel.
Click the 🖼 Images FAB button to show/hide the panel.
Use the search box or filters to find specific images by filename, alt, or iStock ID.
Click download options in the panel to save selected images.
